title: Sequins Sleeveless Mermaid Evening Dress
descriptionHtml:
Turn heads and dazzle the night away in this sleeveless mermaid evening dress! Adorned with shimmering sequins, it features a figure-flattering silhouette and a dramatic flared hemline, perfect for making an unforgettable entrance at any formal event.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Maxi.


Sleeve Style: Sleeveless.


Closure: Back zipper.


Undergarments: Not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises sequins.


Stretch: Fabric is high stretch.
